items.title: Effective finiteness of supersingular modular Jacobians at a fixed prime, including newparts and Atkin-Lehner components
items.author: Aarya J. Kumar; Sargam Mondal; Erick Ross; Hui Xue
items.difficulty_reason: One effective fixed-prime supersingularity finiteness object, not a separate count for the final consequence: the author argument combines effective p-adic Plancherel bounds with the full arithmetic classification of normalized Frobenius conjugate multisets, construction of test functions obstructing cyclotomic imitators, separate p=2 and p>=3 estimates and explicit bounded-family derivations. Old210630 contains only the conjugate-shape lemma; the quantitative distribution obstruction, application to modular Jacobian components and bounded constants are additional nonroutine content. All original good-reduction, nonempty-component, sign-pattern and parameter scope retained; horizontal results and tabulated computations remain uncounted context.

primary.label: Original effective level inequality for new Atkin-Lehner components and all stated analogs, one main object

proof_spans.label: Complete author equidistribution setup, test functions and proof roadmap

Original complete explicit Plancherel function derivations and bounded-family appendix
